description: A token's holders, largest first: address, the explorer's name for it, whether it is a contract, the balance (raw and in whole tokens) and its share of the total supply (0 to 1). Results come 50 per page, newest first; pass "next_cursor" from a result as "cursor" to get the next page. "limit" returns fewer items, but a page cut by limit has no next_cursor, so leave limit out when paging through everything. Names, symbols, tags and method names are set by whoever deployed or verified a contract and are wrapped as untrusted.

limit.description: return at most this many items (1-50, default 50)

name: explorer_token_holders
title: Token holders
